hero.tagline: I build web applications and run the infrastructure they ship on.
hero.intro: I'm a full-stack developer based in Konya, Türkiye. I build web applications with Next.js and Node.js, and I deploy them myself: Docker, GitHub Actions, Coolify and Linux servers. Alongside development I hold the CAPT certification and have completed the full Cisco CCNA track along with CyberOps Associate.

home.experienceDescription: The most recent role on my résumé. Full history on the About page.
home.skillsSubtitle: Full-stack development on a networking and security foundation, shipped on infrastructure I run myself.

footer.tagline: Full-stack development, self-hosted infrastructure, security-minded engineering.

about.title: About
about.description: Full-stack developer in Konya, Türkiye, building web applications and running the infrastructure they ship on.
about.lead: Software engineer specializing in scalable, user-friendly web applications with Next.js, Node.js/Express and MongoDB.
about.body1: I don't stop at writing the code. I build and ship on self-hosted infrastructure (Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Coolify, Traefik and Linux servers) and work in Agile teams, using ClickUp for sprint planning and issue tracking.
about.body2: What sets my work apart is a strong networking and security foundation underneath the application layer: I'm CAPT certified, and I've completed the full Cisco CCNA track along with CyberOps Associate. This means I think about how a system is deployed, exposed and hardened, not just how it's built.
about.body3: Outside of work I spent two years as a GDG Konya organizer and served on the GDG Cloud Konya core team, organizing tech talks, study jams and hands-on workshops for the local developer community.
about.now: Full-Stack Developer at BerrSoft, studying Mathematics and Computer Science at Necmettin Erbakan University
about.languages: Turkish is my native language. I work in written English every day: documentation, repositories and the posts on this site.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Send a message about a project, a role or a question on self-hosted infrastructure. I read every message and reply within a few days.
contact.intro: Open to interesting projects and conversations. The fastest way to reach me is email.
contact.ctaBody: Tell me what you are building. I usually reply within two to three business days.
contact.trustBody: Form data reaches me by email through Resend, the mail provider this site uses, and is not shared or sold anywhere else. Visits are counted by a self-hosted, cookieless Umami instance that keeps no personal data.
contact.responseExpectation: I usually reply within two to three business days.
